column1: # Validation reference anchors — published paper numbers vs simulator output.
# Table-driven; consumed by validation/run_validation.sh. One row = one anchor.
# Columns (comma-separated; the trailing `source` field may contain commas):
#   accelerator : label for the run
#   config      : hw JSON
#   network     : network CSV
#   dataflow    : WS | OS | IS (the modeled class under test)
#   metric      : human name of the compared quantity
#   extract     : recipe against the @LAYER CSV lines (FLEXNPUSIM_LAYER_CSV=1):
#                   L<n>.f<m> = layer n
#                               f4=F^I
#                   SUM.f<m>  = sum of field m over all @LAYER lines
#   published   : the paper/tool number to match (TODO = awaiting a cited value)
#   tol_pct     : pass if |sim-published|/published*100 <= tol_pct
#   confidence  : formula   = analytical perf-model
#                 tool       = number generated by running the reference tool
#                 measured   = silicon/end-to-end (mixes clock/memory/batch; wide tol
#   source      : citation (paper/table/tool + the exact quantity)
# --- WS: NVDLA perf-model — the existing gold anchor (see validation/README.md) ---
# sim reproduces NVDLA's nv_full INT16 perf model from hardware constants alone.
nvdla-large
nvdla-large
